title: I love these.
text: I love these.. These lanterns looks great. I'm using them as ivy planter holders. They look so nice and are well made. I'm only giving 4 stars because one of the lanterns didn't have the rivet attached to the handle.  I did find all but one piece in the box and was able to put it back together.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Cylindrical Stoneware Candle Holder Lantern Home Decor Set - Set of 2, Gray and Cream
features: These 2 stoneware lanterns boast an elegant reactive glaze with flecks of blue. Light from a votive candle can shine through the rectangular cutouts, and the handles provide easy transport.
Can be used with candles or on their own
